shorts: Tailored chino shorts ending above the knee
formal_wear: Tailored 2-piece single-breasted suits with moderate shoulder padding

trapezoid.stylist_explanation: The trapezoid silhouette possesses naturally balanced proportions with broad shoulders and a mild taper to the waist. The styling objective is to maintain this equilibrium through well-tailored cuts that follow the natural contour of the body without adding artificial bulk.

rectangle.description: Shoulders, waist, and hips are of relatively uniform width. Straight vertical silhouette.

shirts: Layered button-down shirts with chest flap pockets
jackets: Structured bomber jackets with waist ribbing
jeans: Straight-leg jeans with back pocket detailing

poor_fitting_garments: Droopy unconstructed oversized garments emphasizing straight lines
necklines: Deep V-neck t-shirts elongating the torso vertically
jacket_styles: Unconstructed soft-shoulder cardigan jackets lacking shape
trouser_fits: Skin-tight skinny trousers highlighting a uniform leg width

rectangle.stylist_explanation: The rectangle silhouette features aligned shoulders, waist, and hips. Stylist strategy focuses on building structure around the shoulders and chest using chest pockets, horizontal layering, double-breasted blazers, and textured fabrics to create a illusion of a tapered torso.

triangle.description: Shoulders and chest are narrower than the waist and hips. Lower torso is wider than upper body.

shirts: Shirts with epaulettes or shoulder seam detail
t_shirts: Structured crew-neck t-shirts with shoulder color blocking
blazers: Single-breasted blazers with wide peak lapels and structured shoulders
shorts: Flat-front casual shorts ending just above the knee
formal_wear: Single-breasted 2-button suits with padded shoulders and structured chest canvas

poor_fitting_garments: Tops ending right at the widest point of hips
necklines: Polo shirts with tight narrow collars
jacket_styles: Double-breasted jackets drawing attention to waist width
trouser_fits: Tapered or skinny leg trousers accentuating hip width in contrast

triangle.stylist_explanation: The triangle silhouette has a wider waist/hip region relative to the shoulders. The styling objective is to broaden the shoulders using structured shoulder pads, wide lapels, and horizontal chest details while streamlining the lower body with clean, dark, straight-leg trousers.

oval.description: Fuller midsection and torso with narrower shoulders and legs. Central torso volume.

blazers: Single-breasted 2-button dark blazers ending below hip bone
pants: Straight dark trousers worn at natural waist
shorts: Flat-front Bermuda shorts in dark shades
formal_wear: Single-breasted 2-button dark suits with low button stance and vertical pinstripes

poor_fitting_garments: Tight fitted t-shirts clinging to midsection
necklines: High tight crew-necks cutting off neck length
jacket_styles: Double-breasted coats creating double fabric volume across waist
trouser_fits: Pleated pants adding extra fabric volume at waist

oval.stylist_explanation: The oval silhouette features volume concentrated in the midsection. Stylist strategy emphasizes elongating the torso using vertical pinstripes, V-necklines, dark monochromatic color schemes, and single-breasted longline jackets left open to create vertical slimming lines.

inverted_triangle.description: Significantly broader shoulders and chest with a narrow waist and hips. Athletic V-taper.

blazers: Unstructured 1-button or 2-button blazers with soft shoulders
formal_wear: Unpadded 1-button single-breasted suits with soft natural shoulder construction

poor_fitting_garments: Heavy shoulder pads amplifying already broad shoulders
necklines: Boat-neck tops or wide necklines extending shoulder width further
jacket_styles: Wide peak-lapel double-breasted jackets causing top-heavy distortion
trouser_fits: Skin-tight skinny jeans creating an exaggerated top-heavy funnel shape

inverted_triangle.stylist_explanation: The inverted triangle silhouette features an athletic V-taper with prominent shoulder width. Stylist strategy focuses on softening the upper body with unconstructed soft shoulders and V-necklines while adding slight volume to the lower body with straight-leg denim to balance the overall proportions.
